bottlenecks.title: Mobile Load Delay Costing Sales Conversions
bottlenecks.impactText: Your mobile page takes 2.6s to render the main content. Google studies show pages exceeding 2.5s lose ~15% of potential clients before the main CTA renders.
bottlenecks.recommendation: Optimize hero asset rendering, implement Next.js edge caching, and defer blocking scripts.

bottlenecks.title: Underutilized AI Search Entity Schemas
bottlenecks.impactText: Detected basic schema (Generic). Lacks enriched Product/Service and FAQ schemas for direct AI answer placement.
bottlenecks.recommendation: Expand structured data with rich FAQs, Service offers, and geo-targeted metadata.

bottlenecks.title: Sub-Optimal Mobile Viewport & Layout Shift
bottlenecks.impactText: Mobile layout shifts cause mis-clicks during user navigation, leading to frustrating drop-offs on checkout and consultation buttons.
bottlenecks.recommendation: Implement strict aspect-ratio containers for imagery and fix un-sized dynamic elements.
